rules.source_quote: All non-essential outdoor manual excavation and earthmoving shall remain suspended under Stage III.
Total cessation of outdoor civic construction and linear public works under Stage IV.

rehearsal_adaptation.stage_I: Full shifts allowed with advisory dust suppression
rehearsal_adaptation.stage_II: Water sprinkling mandatory; heavy shifts rotated
rehearsal_adaptation.stage_III: S1 earthwork suspended; crew reassigned to indoor depot maintenance
rehearsal_adaptation.stage_IV: All outdoor work halted; paid standby
